summary: instagram-bridge talks to Instagram only through its gateway package.
reason: Internal refactor, behaviour-preserving (design/instagram-adoption/17 P7). Every instameow call now goes through one of two helpers in internal/gateway/instameow: `call` for the typed library methods and `graphql` for raw documents. Both open the upstream span, and `graphql` checks the transport status and the GraphQL errors array before data. The same helpers map failures onto the closed domain error set: a challenge, checkpoint, consent or dead token becomes needs-a-human (409) and Instagram's too-long refusal becomes too-large (413). The HTTP status mapping now reads only those kinds, which makes the P6 fragment's claim that the set drives the mapping true. Instagram's wire structs, the session supervisor, inbound event normalization and the session files moved into internal/gateway/instameow, internal/session, internal/stream and internal/observability. Span names, parents and attributes are unchanged, with one deliberate addition: a raw GraphQL 200 whose body is not JSON now marks its span as failed. P4's contract fixtures are regenerated byte-identical by the moved code, and the image build marks itself so the fixture check, whose files sit outside the build context, skips there instead of failing the build. No route, path, status code or JSON shape changes.
